title: Admin person supervises a service-owned review
description: Connect an admin person and create a service-owned review workspace on an isolated gateway. Read its frozen Git diff through the actual Companion client and confirm the native execution owner stays the service. The pre-fix ownership guard must fail this same read. Gate resolution and pinned worker attachment/control are covered by typed gateway tests.

supervise.intent: Read a service-owned review as an admin person and preserve its native owner.
